<style>
@media only screen and (max-width: 768px) {
    /* 1. Reset Global e Prevenção de Transbordamento Horizontal */
    *, *::before, *::after {
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
    }

    html, body, #nr-dashboard {
        width: 100% !important;
        max-width: 100% !important;
        overflow-x: hidden !important;
        margin: 0 !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
        position: relative !important;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch !important;
    }

    /* 2. Containers Intermediários do Angular Material */
    md-toolbar,
    .md-toolbar-tools,
    section[layout="row"],
    md-content,
    md-content.maincontent,
    div[ui-masonry],
    ui-card-panel,
    .nr-dashboard-cardpanel {
        width: 100% !important;
        max-width: 100% !important;
        overflow-x: hidden !important;
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
        margin-left: 0 !important;
        margin-right: 0 !important;
        padding-left: 4px !important;
        padding-right: 4px !important;
    }

    .md-toolbar-tools {
        padding-left: 8px !important;
        padding-right: 8px !important;
    }

    .md-toolbar-tools h1 {
        font-size: 16px !important;
        white-space: nowrap !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
        text-overflow: ellipsis !important;
    }

    p.nr-dashboard-cardtitle {
        width: 100% !important;
        max-width: 100% !important;
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
    }

    /* 3. Painel e Grid Container Flexível */
    .nr-dashboard-cardcontainer {
        display: flex !important;
        flex-wrap: wrap !important;
        justify-content: space-between !important;
        align-items: stretch !important;
        width: 100% !important;
        max-width: 100% !important;
        min-width: 0 !important;
        height: auto !important;
        position: relative !important;
        margin: 0 auto !important;
        padding: 4px 0 !important;
        gap: 8px !important;
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
        overflow-x: hidden !important;
    }

    /* 4. Cada card (md-card) filho passa a fluir no layout flex com largura total */
    .nr-dashboard-cardcontainer > md-card {
        position: relative !important;
        left: auto !important;
        top: auto !important;
        right: auto !important;
        bottom: auto !important;
        width: 100% !important;
        max-width: 100% !important;
        min-width: 0 !important;
        height: auto !important;
        min-height: 48px !important;
        margin: 0 !important;
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
        flex: 1 1 100% !important;
    }

    /* Em tablets pequenos ou telas landscape (481px a 768px), componentes de 6 colunas formam pares lado a lado */
    @media only screen and (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 768px) {
        .nr-dashboard-cardcontainer > md-card[ui-card-size^="6x"] {
            width: calc(50% - 4px) !important;
            flex: 1 1 calc(50% - 4px) !important;
            max-width: calc(50% - 4px) !important;
        }
    }

    /* 5. Centralização Perfeita do Manômetro / Gráfico (JustGage) no Mobile */
    md-card[node-id="gauge"] {
        display: flex !important;
        flex-direction: column !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        justify-content: center !important;
        text-align: center !important;
    }

    .nr-dashboard-gauge,
    div[id^="gauge_"] {
        max-width: 100% !important;
        width: 100% !important;
        height: auto !important;
        box-sizing: border-box !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;

<script>
// Garante centralização e escala perfeita do gráfico de manômetro (JustGage/Raphaël) no celular
(function() {
    function autoCenterGauge() {
        var svg = document.querySelector('.nr-dashboard-gauge svg');
        if (!svg) return;
        if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
            if (svg.getBBox) {
                try {
                    var bb = svg.getBBox();
                    if (bb.width > 0 && bb.height > 0) {
                        var pad = 10;
                        var vx = bb.x - pad;
                        var vy = bb.y - pad;
                        var vw = bb.width + (pad * 2);
                        var vh = bb.height + (pad * 2);
                        var newVb = vx + " " + vy + " " + vw + " " + vh;
                        if (svg.getAttribute('viewBox') !== newVb) {
                            svg.setAttribute('viewBox', newVb);
                            svg.setAttribute('preserveAspectRatio', 'xMidYMid meet');
                        }
                    }
                } catch(e) {}
            }
        } else {
            if (svg.getAttribute('viewBox')) {
                svg.removeAttribute('viewBox');
                svg.removeAttribute('preserveAspectRatio');
            }
        }
    }
    setInterval(autoCenterGauge, 500);
})();
</script>
